summary: Reach for this whenever a task touches YouTube, whether or not the word appears: a pasted watch/shorts/channel/playlist link, a bare 11-char video ID or @handle, a creator to look up, a talk to summarize, quote or translate, research where lectures, tutorials and reviews beat written sources, or a product launch to catch on video. One skill for transcripts, video and channel search, channel browsing, in-channel search, playlists and 4,000-video batch jobs. Skip it for uploads, comments and account chores.
